fields.label: Crypto Key
fields.help: The name of the cryptoKey associated with the CryptoKeyVersions.

fields.label: Deletion Policy
fields.help: Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the instance.

fields.label: State
fields.help: The current state of the CryptoKeyVersion.

fields.label: External Protection Level Options
Ekm Connection Key Path
fields.help: The path to the external key material on the EKM when using EkmConnection e.g., "v0/my/key".

fields.label: External Key Uri
fields.help: The URI for an external resource that this CryptoKeyVersion represents.
ExternalProtectionLevelOptions stores a group of additional fields for configuring a CryptoKeyVersion that are specific to the EXTERNAL protection level and EXTERNAL_VPC protection levels.
